ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a large triangle ADE, with A on the left side, D at the upper right, and E at the lower right; point C is located on side AD, and point B is located on side AE. Segment CB connects the points on the two sides, and CB and the DE on the right side are both drawn with arrow markings in the same direction, indicating CB ∥ DE. Reasoning: The problem gives AC = x - 3, CD = x + 5, AB = 16, BE = 20. Because in triangle ADE, CB ∥ DE, according to the triangle proportionality theorem, the parallel line divides the other two sides into proportional segments: AC/CD = AB/BE. Substituting the values gives (x - 3)/(x + 5) = 16/20. Simplify 16/20 = 4/5, so 5(x - 3) = 4(x + 5). Expanding gives 5x - 15 = 4x + 20, therefore x = 35.

Read from the text AC=x-3, CD=x+5, AB=16, and BE=20. First compute the whole sides: AD=AC+CD=2x+2 and AE=AB+BE=36. Because CB is parallel to DE, triangles ABC and ADE are similar. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个大三角形 ADE，A 在左侧，D 在右上方，E 在右下方。点 C 位于边 AD 上，点 B 位于边 AE 上，线段 CB 连接 C 和 B。图中 CB 与 DE 上有相同方向的箭头标记，表示 CB ∥ DE。因此小三角形 ABC 与大三角形 ADE 共用顶点 A，且对应边平行。

推理：已知 AC = x - 3，CD = x + 5，所以整条边 AD = AC + CD = (x - 3) + (x + 5) = 2x + 2。已知 AB = 16，BE = 20，所以 AE = AB + BE = 16 + 20 = 36。因为 CB ∥ DE，所以 △ABC ∼ △ADE。对应边成比例：AC/AD = AB/AE。代入得到 (x - 3)/(2x + 2) = 16/36。化简并求解：36(x - 3) = 16(2x + 2)，36x - 108 = 32x + 32，4x = 140，所以 x = 35。
